name: Amulite baseplate
description: Supports the motor mount, journal housings and service modules on a common datum.
function: Establishes the machine reference plane and transfers reaction loads into four feet.
mounting: Top datum at Z = 0 mm. Mount patterns are pending drawing release.
limits: Verify flatness and deflection under combined static and dynamic loads.
maintenance: Check for distortion, looseness and damage at the mounting points.
sourcing: Candidate definition; supplier and part number pending.
proposedSpecification: 300 x 200 x 6 mm aluminum plate; composite overlay optional

name: Isolating feet
description: Four compliant feet support the baseplate at its corners.
function: Reduce transmission to the bench over a characterized frequency range.
mounting: Four corner positions on the underside of TE-001.
limits: Measure mounted mass, compression, stiffness and damping before selection.
maintenance: Inspect loaded height, damage and aging.
sourcing: Candidate definition; supplier and part number pending.
proposedSpecification: elastomer, selected by measured mass

name: BLDC motor
description: Brushless DC drive at the negative-X end of the shaft line.
function: Applies torque through the flexible coupling to the supported rotor shaft.
mounting: Motor feet attach via the stationary isolation mount.
equations: J dΩ/dt = τₘ − τₐ − bΩ − τd
limits: Obtain the torque–speed curve, current limits and stall behavior.
maintenance: Review motor temperature history and inspect connection strain relief.
sourcing: Candidate definition; supplier and part number pending.
proposedSpecification: 24 V, ~50 W, compatible driver, rated to 3000 rpm

name: Motor controller
description: Electronic speed controller for the brushless motor.
function: Commutates the motor and enforces configured electrical limits.
mounting: Mount on an electrically suitable, thermally characterized tray.
ports: Independent motor energy or safe-enable path
Bounded speed request and driver status
limits: Verify controller limits and separate hardware enable behavior.
maintenance: Review recorded faults and inspect terminals after de-energizing.
sourcing: Candidate definition; supplier and part number pending.
proposedSpecification: 24 V BLDC ESC with speed control and current limiting

name: Main shaft
description: Steel shaft centered on the X axis and spanning two radial bearing stations.
function: Transfers drive torque while locating the rotor between the bearings.
mounting: Nominal Ø8 mm journals. Shoulder, fit and end retention details pending.
limits: Critical speed, fatigue, deflection and fits require verification.
maintenance: Inspect journals and retention features during isolated service.
sourcing: Candidate definition; supplier and part number pending.
proposedSpecification: 8 mm nominal steel, shoulders/retention as engineered

name: Spurving bearings
description: Two rolling-element bearings support the shaft at the journal stations.
function: Transmit rotor and shaft reaction loads to aligned stationary housings.
mounting: Nominal Ø8 mm bore. A 608-series bearing is a candidate.
limits: Check equivalent load, life, contamination and locating/floating arrangement.
maintenance: Trend temperature and vibration and inspect seals during isolated service.
sourcing: Candidate definition; supplier and part number pending.
proposedSpecification: 8 mm bore radial bearings, e.g. 608-series where fit permits

name: Bearing housings
description: Two rigid pedestals locate the bearing outer rings above the base datum.
function: Constrain the shaft axis through repeatable mounting and alignment.
mounting: Bolted pedestal to base. Coaxiality is pending a fit and tolerance study.
limits: Check housing stiffness, alignment and outer-ring retention.
maintenance: Check movement, mounting preload and alignment after any removal.
sourcing: Candidate definition; supplier and part number pending.
proposedSpecification: aligned, bolted housings

name: Marzelvane hub
description: Central hub with six equally spaced vane seats and positive shaft retention.
function: Distributes shaft torque and provides a common radial datum for the vane set.
mounting: Concentric on TE-005 with retention through TE-010.
limits: Verify interface torque capacity, stress concentration and balance.
maintenance: Inspect seating surfaces and retention after isolated disassembly.
sourcing: Candidate definition; supplier and part number pending.
proposedSpecification: machined aluminum hub with positive shaft retention

name: Hydrocoptic vanes
description: Six identical radial inserts indexed around the Marzelvane hub.
function: Sweep the unpressurized air volume and contribute to rotor inertia and aerodynamic drag.
mounting: Six indexed seats on TE-008. Final joint and retention geometry are pending.
limits: Establish fatigue, retention, balance and containment evidence before operation.
maintenance: Inspect for root damage and fretting with the drive isolated. Balance the installed set after replacement.
sourcing: Candidate definition; supplier and part number pending.
proposedSpecification: identical, guarded, balanced vane inserts

name: Rotor retaining system
description: Shaft and hub retention hardware at the rotor interface.
function: Constrains relative axial motion and maintains positive rotor retention.
mounting: Located at the hub face concentric with the shaft.
limits: Verify preload, anti-loosening method and dynamic retention.
maintenance: Check witness marks and replace locking hardware per the selected component specification.
sourcing: Candidate definition; supplier and part number pending.
proposedSpecification: locking hardware specified to rotor geometry

name: Girdle spring isolator
description: Compliant stationary motor mount beneath the drive.
function: Provides a characterized motor support outside the rotating torque path.
mounting: Between drive motor and base. Maintain acceptable coupling alignment under load.
limits: Measure stiffness, damping and run-up transmissibility.
maintenance: Inspect compression, alignment drift and signs of contact.
sourcing: Candidate definition; supplier and part number pending.
proposedSpecification: replaceable elastomer/spring-damper mount

name: Panametric fan
description: Independently powered axial cooling fan with guard.
function: Moves ambient air through the service duct independently of rotor speed.
mounting: Fan frame registers to the duct interface.
limits: Verify operating point against fan curve and measured duct loss.
maintenance: Inspect fan guard and dust accumulation with power isolated.
sourcing: Candidate definition; supplier and part number pending.
proposedSpecification: 24 V guarded axial fan

name: Air duct/filter
description: Removable cooling duct and filter service section.
function: Guides cooling flow and provides access to the filter.
mounting: Duct mates to TE-012 and the casing air interface.
limits: Measure restriction with clean and loaded filter states.
maintenance: Track pressure loss and clean or replace filter media as qualified.
sourcing: Candidate definition; supplier and part number pending.
proposedSpecification: removable intake and exhaust duct

name: Logarithmic casing
description: Segmented protective casing with an inspection window and service panels.
function: Separates rotating components from access and supports the guard interlock.
material: Transparent and opaque panels, grades TBD
mounting: Mounts to the baseplate around the swept volume.
limits: Containment, panel joints, clearances and interlock performance require verification.
maintenance: Inspect windows, seams, fasteners and interlock alignment before service release.
sourcing: Candidate definition; supplier and part number pending.
proposedSpecification: rigid transparent guard + opaque service panels

name: Spiral-channel insert
description: Optional removable spiral-profile channel insert.
function: Provides a testable airflow path within the casing.
mounting: Nonstructural insert registers to the guard inner interface.
limits: Verify clearance and characterize pressure loss and flow distribution.
maintenance: Inspect seating, wear and contamination with the drive isolated.
sourcing: Candidate definition; supplier and part number pending.
proposedSpecification: optional nonstructural removable duct

name: ESP32 controller
description: Microcontroller for measurement, telemetry and supervisory state.
function: Timestamps sensor observations and enforces quality gates for phase analysis.
mounting: Mounts within the service enclosure on insulated supports.
ports: Bounded speed request and driver status
limits: Verify logic levels, timing, watchdog and independent motor inhibit.
maintenance: Review fault history and verify firmware revision and configuration.
sourcing: Candidate definition; supplier and part number pending.
proposedSpecification: 3.3 V logic microcontroller

name: IMU
description: Three-axis accelerometer with a local rigid mounting interface.
function: Observes housing acceleration for transverse vibration analysis.
mounting: Couple rigidly to a bearing housing and document sensor orientation.
equations: M ÿ + C ẏ + Ky = Fᵧ
limits: Verify sensitivity, bandwidth, anti-alias filtering and saturation detection.
maintenance: Inspect mounting rigidity and verify channel calibration.
sourcing: Candidate definition; supplier and part number pending.
proposedSpecification: 3-axis accelerometer, suitable sampling bandwidth

name: Tachometer
description: Speed pickup and rotating target provide one indexed timing reference per calibrated pulse count.
function: Converts edge intervals to speed and anchors synchronous phase.
mounting: Fixed pickup near the shaft. Target placement and clearance require verification.
limits: Check pulses per revolution, edge jitter and dropout detection.
maintenance: Inspect pickup clearance, alignment and pulse stability.
sourcing: Candidate definition; supplier and part number pending.
proposedSpecification: Hall/optical sensor plus target

name: Temperature probes
description: Two thermal probes observe motor and bearing temperature.
function: Provide trend and overtemperature inputs at defined mounting points.
mounting: Thermally coupled to motor case and one bearing housing.
limits: Calibrate response and verify thermal lag and channel assignment.
maintenance: Check attachment, lead damage and calibration drift.
sourcing: Candidate definition; supplier and part number pending.
proposedSpecification: motor/bearing temperature

name: Bus monitor
description: Voltage and current measurement at the DC bus.
function: Supplies synchronized bus measurements for input power estimates.
mounting: Observe the protected bus at a documented measurement boundary.
limits: Verify scale, offset, bandwidth and fault isolation.
maintenance: Review zero offset and inspect measurement connection integrity.
sourcing: Candidate definition; supplier and part number pending.
proposedSpecification: voltage and current sensing, isolated as needed

name: Emergency stop
description: Latching emergency stop at the operator-accessible edge.
function: Requests independent motor energy removal or safe disable through the hardware path.
mounting: Accessible outside the rotor guard.
ports: Independent motor energy or safe-enable path
limits: Verify stop behavior, latching, power restoration and restart inhibition.
maintenance: Function-test at commissioning and at the interval established by risk assessment.
sourcing: Candidate definition; supplier and part number pending.
proposedSpecification: latching switch interrupting motor-enable/power safely

name: DC power supply
description: Certified supply candidate within the 24 V DC system boundary.
function: Supplies the protected DC distribution path.
mounting: Service bay location with reserved airflow and wiring clearance.
limits: Verify loading, inrush, fault current and thermal conditions.
maintenance: Inspect connectors and ventilation and review supply fault history.
sourcing: Candidate definition; supplier and part number pending.
proposedSpecification: certified 24 V, appropriately rated and fused

name: Main fuse and disconnect
description: Service disconnect and main fuse in the DC distribution path.
function: Provides isolation and overcurrent protection at a defined boundary.
mounting: Located upstream of motor and logic branches.
limits: Select fuse and disconnect against source fault current and conductor ratings.
maintenance: Verify fuse labeling and isolate supply before inspection.
sourcing: Candidate definition; supplier and part number pending.
proposedSpecification: sized after measured current and wire rating

name: Interlock switch
description: Fixed guard-position switch at the service opening.
function: Inhibits drive enable when the guard condition falls outside its qualified state.
mounting: Actuated at the mating guard edge.
limits: Verify fail-safe response, alignment tolerance and restart inhibit.
maintenance: Inspect actuator alignment and verify open-guard response.
sourcing: Candidate definition; supplier and part number pending.
proposedSpecification: prevents motor run with guard open

name: Controller enclosure
description: Ventilated service enclosure around the control electronics.
function: Protects boards and provides guided wiring and strain relief.
mounting: Bolts to base with accessible protected cable exits.
limits: Verify ingress, service access and component temperatures.
maintenance: Inspect vents, cover and strain relief.
sourcing: Candidate definition; supplier and part number pending.
proposedSpecification: insulated, ventilated, strain-relieved

name: Harness
description: Harness routes motor power, sensor signals and supervision wiring.
function: Provides labeled, keyed interconnects with controlled return paths.
material: Insulated copper conductors and jacket TBD
mounting: Clamped to stationary routed interfaces outside the swept rotor volume.
limits: Check continuity, voltage drop, EMC and wire strain.
maintenance: Inspect rubbing, retention and connector seating after isolation.
sourcing: Candidate definition; supplier and part number pending.
proposedSpecification: keyed connectors, labeled conductors, cable restraint

name: Phase-analysis firmware
description: Firmware module that estimates phase from paired synchronous observations.
function: Reports band-specific phase and coherence and qualifies any bounded speed request.
mounting: Executes on the TE-016 measurement controller.
limits: Verify frequency observability, channel delay, uncertainty and invalid-signal behavior.
maintenance: Record revision and repeat deterministic and hardware-in-loop checks after changes.
sourcing: Firmware definition; release evidence pending.
proposedSpecification: digital filters, phase estimator, bounded controller

name: Optional torque sensor
description: Optional future inline transducer represented at its reserved shaft station.
function: Would measure shaft torque for a common-boundary power audit.
mounting: Reference location only. Shaft adaptation, axial stack and calibration remain open.
limits: Verify range, uncertainty, bandwidth and parasitic alignment loads.
maintenance: Inspect and calibrate per the selected transducer instructions.
sourcing: Candidate definition; supplier and part number pending.
proposedSpecification: inline rated torque transducer, later revision

name: Fasteners
description: Representative fastener set for mounted hardware and casing joints.
function: Transfers joint loads and maintains component retention.
mounting: Mounting positions are schematic. Joint-specific schedules are pending.
limits: Verify preload, thread engagement and locking for each joint.
maintenance: Inspect witness marks and check joints against the released torque schedule.
sourcing: Candidate definition; supplier and part number pending.
proposedSpecification: graded, torque-specified, locking as required

name: Shaft coupling
description: Flexible drive coupling at the motor-to-main-shaft interface.
function: Transfers torque while accommodating qualified alignment error.
mounting: Coaxial hubs at the negative-X end of the main shaft.
limits: Verify speed, torque, misalignment and clamp retention under startup load.
maintenance: Inspect alignment, hub position and elastomer condition.
sourcing: Candidate definition; supplier and part number pending.
proposedSpecification: rated flexible coupling between motor and supported shaft
